<https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term> a delphi:Claim ;
    rdfs:label "The design scorer's composite has never beaten its own strongest single term, the joint Mahalanobis term, on the primary ranking endpoint P1." ;
    dct:description "STATUS: this is an observed result, not a theory. It comes from the blind held-out run of scorer version 1.3.0, scored family-out over 168 held-out families (SCORER-EVALUATION.md:14), run by an evaluator who built neither the scorer nor the benchmark; dev results count for nothing (SCORER-EVALUATION.md:13). What was seen: the composite rank_score beats nearest-neighbour distance on P1 at 0.875 (+0.032, CI 0.026 to 0.040; SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33), but against the joint Mahalanobis term used alone the P1 difference is -0.008, CI -0.020 to 0.002, so it is not significantly better on P1 (SCORER-EVALUATION.md:35). Over all held-out items the composite is significantly worse than the joint term alone: -0.007, CI -0.013 to -0.002 (SCORER-EVALUATION.md:36). The joint term alone reaches P1 0.883 and passes all three primary endpoints by itself (SCORER-EVALUATION.md:38). DOES NOT ESTABLISH: (1) that the other components are useless; they earn their place only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5, which the joint term alone fails (SCORER-EVALUATION.md:43). (2) that the composite is worse on P1 specifically; the P1 difference interval spans zero, so P1 alone shows no significant gap either way. (3) anything beyond these 168 families or beyond scorer version 1.3.0; other scorer versions and other family sets are untested by this result. Source locators: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:14, :33, :35, :36, :38, :43, :13." ;
    delphi:hasEvidence <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term> .

<https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term> a delphi:EvidenceItem ;
    rdfs:label "Held-out comparison of the v1.3.0 rank_score composite against nearest-neighbour distance and against its joint Mahalanobis term alone" ;
    dct:description "Numbers are transcribed from sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md, at lines :14 (run scope: 168 held-out families, scored family-out), :33 (rank_score vs nearest-neighbour on P1), :35 (rank_score vs joint term alone on P1), :36 (all held-out items), :38 (joint term alone on P1), :43 (other components help only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5) and :13 (evaluator built neither scorer nor benchmark). All figures come from the blind held-out run of v1.3.0, 168 held-out families scored family-out; development results are not counted." ;

        sub:pv-diff-vs-joint-p1 ,

sub:pv-p1-rank-score a schema:PropertyValue ;

sub:pv-diff-vs-nn a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_rank_score_minus_nearest_neighbour" ;
    schema:value "0.032"^^xsd:decimal ;

    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_vs_nearest_neighbour_ci_low" ;

sub:pv-diff-vs-nn-ci-high a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_vs_nearest_neighbour_ci_high" ;
    schema:value "0.040"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Upper confidence bound of the difference versus nearest-neighbour on P1. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33" .

sub:pv-joint-alone-p1 a schema:PropertyValue ;
